name: FormCut
title: local-first video editing with no account and no upload
summary: FormCut is an open-source video editor: multi-track timeline, one renderer for preview and export, a real effect catalogue, local captions and cutout, and an MCP server.
lede: FormCut is a complete video editor that runs entirely on your machine, with no account and no upload. A multi-track timeline, one renderer shared by preview and export, a catalogue of grades, effects and transitions, captions and subject cutout from local models, and a scripting API come in a desktop shell. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor can build, render and collect an edit over MCP.
checks: Previews and exports through one renderer, so the frame you approve is the frame you ship, held by a golden-frame check in CI.
Browses 74 colour grades, 76 visual effects, 48 audio chains, 23 transitions and a library of 180 looks.
Transcribes with Whisper locally, removes backgrounds with models that ship in the engine and tracks subjects, planes and rotoscoped shapes.
Exports H.264, HEVC, AV1 and VP9 with hardware encoders, and exchanges timelines as OpenTimelineIO, EDL and Final Cut XML.

facts.dd: .fc, a package with the document, every media file, fonts, LUTs and shaders
Python and FastAPI with a Rust frame executor and a 3D device pass, in a Tauri 2 shell
16 languages, Arabic, Persian and Hebrew right to left
The engine binds loopback, model downloads are pinned by SHA-256 and there is no telemetry

chapters.title: What you see is what you export
chapters.text: The same decode, crop, colour, effect, mask, grade, transform and composite path serves the canvas and the file. Proxy editing keeps 4K scrubbing light, and exports always read the originals.

chapters.title: A catalogue that is real
chapters.text: 74 colour grades, 76 visual effects, 48 audio chains, 23 transitions and 180 looks, each with a thumbnail rendered by the engine, plus scopes, wheels, curves and effect packages you import yourself.

chapters.title: Speech and subject models run locally
chapters.text: Whisper in tiny to large sizes writes captions with word timestamps, and a transcript row marks a range from the speech found in the audio so the timeline makes the cut. Background removal works out of the box, with Point to select (SAM 2) tracking an object through video.

features.title: One renderer for preview and export
features.text: Pixel-measured parameters follow the resolution actually decoded.
bullets: Frames with an effect, mask or transform go through the renderer
A plain cut and untouched layers export through ffmpeg filtergraphs with the grade baked into a 33-point cube
Golden-frame check in CI compares the two paths on every push

features.title: Effect catalogue
features.text: Browsable and real: every card's thumbnail is rendered by the engine.
bullets: 74 colour grades, 76 visual effects, 48 audio chains and 23 transitions
180 looks, twenty colour grades each with nine finishes
Effect packages: a manifest, a WGSL kernel or an audio filter chain, each checked before it loads
A community registry installs packages from the effects browser

features.title: Voiceover, camera and screen recording
features.text: Recording straight onto the timeline from Studio's Recording tab.
bullets: Microphone with a device picker and peak-holding level meter
Camera previewed live before and during a take
Screen or window with system sound and your microphone mixed in

features.title: Cutout and scene tools
features.text: Background removal that works out of the box.
bullets: Subject (Auto), Point to select (SAM 2) and a smart brush
Scene detection splits long clips at their cuts
Smooth slow motion that makes the frames between
Canvas backgrounds: a colour, gradient, image or blurred copy of the clip

features.title: Editing surface
features.text: Multi-timeline with compound clips, which also serve as multicam.
bullets: Multi-track, marquee, trim, blade, ripple delete and freeze frame
Reorderable timeline tabs and any timeline placed on another as a compound clip
Detach and reattach audio, crop with canvas grips
A Pro tab with a source monitor, three-point editing, roll, slip and slide, and Premiere, Final Cut and Avid key layouts

features.title: Color grading
features.text: A Color tab with scopes and a colour-managed BT.709 pipeline.
bullets: Waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope and histogram
Lift, gamma, gain and offset wheels and custom luma and RGB curves
Hue against hue, hue against saturation and luminance against saturation curves
PQ and HLG sources tone-mapped at decode; every export tagged BT.709

features.title: Keyframes and tracking
features.text: Cubic-bezier easing with named presets and handles of your own.
bullets: Keyframes on transform properties and any effect parameter
Motion tracking pins a title or overlay to a moving subject
Planar tracking and roto in the Track workspace
Screen replacement and device mockups rendered in 3D

features.title: Captions and speech
features.text: Whisper in the engine's own ONNX Runtime.
bullets: tiny, base, small, medium or large models
Word timestamps and SCC, SRT and WebVTT caption files
Transcript rows mark a range and the timeline cuts it

features.title: Library and Studio
features.text: Built-in assets plus sources you import.
bullets: 86 stickers and 52 sound effects
Pexels stock and Openverse sounds, music and images with licence and attribution
A media downloader for any site yt-dlp supports

features.title: Export and interchange
features.text: Hardware encoders preferred and confirmed by encoding.
bullets: H.264, HEVC, AV1 and VP9, 10-bit where the encoder supports it
OpenTimelineIO, CMX 3600 EDL, Final Cut Pro 7 XML and FCPXML both ways
Projects export as a .fc package from the home screen

features.title: Media in
bullets: HEIC, HEIF, AVIF and TIFF stills
PQ and HLG footage tone-mapped to SDR in the decode pipe
Proxy editing built in the background, never used for export

features.title: Automation and MCP
features.text: JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP, websocket, stdin, TCP and gRPC.
bullets: MCP server with 32 workflow tools over stdio, built into the app as formcut-engine --mcp
Settings, Connections, AI agents shows each client's config with a Copy button
Optimistic concurrency on every edit

parity.summary: Revision 13 re-grades FormCut from 2.8.1 to 2.10.1, fifteen releases and 42 commits, and no grade moved: it was full on every row but the phone app, and still is. It has 13 of 13 capabilities beyond CapCut. Concat and UltraMock are the other columns.

docs.agents: A built-in MCP server with 32 workflow tools; from a checkout, ./formcut mcp, with .mcp.json, .codex/config.toml and .cursor/mcp.json already set up.

topics.title: Download
topics.text: Each release carries a zip for macOS (Apple silicon), Windows and Linux that runs with nothing else installed, ffmpeg included.

topics.title: Ports
topics.text: The interface runs at http://localhost:3040 and the engine at http://127.0.0.1:8040.

topics.title: MCP server
topics.text: The README lists how Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop and VS Code connect, and Settings, Connections shows the exact command.

topics.title: Local speech
topics.text: setup/setup_local_ai re-runs the Kokoro speech runtime install on its own.

topics.title: Releasing
topics.text: RELEASING.md covers releases, which formcompiler builds from a compile_vX.Y.Z branch.

items: The About box and the installers name NodeAgentc, Inc. and the licence
The Windows LGPL FFmpeg build runs under cmd
The engine checks pass on every OS again
